0022600088.text: Both the Toronto Raptors and the Chicago Bulls open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Raptors hosting. Brandon Ingram is out for Toronto after Achilles surgery, while Chucky Hepburn and Nate Bittle are day-to-day with hamstring and foot injuries and are game-time decisions, and Chicago's Nic Claxton is also a day-to-day game-time decision with a hamstring injury. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win.
